headline: Knicks Top Tonight's NBA Slate
caption:
Three NBA games tonight, and our model's most confident pick is the Knicks at 74% over the 76ers. Projection: NY 114.9, PHI 107.5. Strong lean, not a lock: Philly still takes this one roughly a quarter of the time.

The matchup to watch is Thunder at Spurs, as close to a coin flip as it gets. San Antonio gets the slightest nod at 52%, projected 113.3 to 112.7.

In Detroit, the Pistons are the pick at 59% over the Celtics, projected 109.7 to 107.1, and Boston wins this one about four times in ten. Swipe for every pick, win chance and projected score.

Which underdog do you trust tonight: the Celtics in Detroit or the Thunder in San Antonio?

games.game: Oklahoma City Thunder at San Antonio Spurs
